description: Jump to the definition of the symbol at a file path plus 1-based line number. Returns definition locations with code and signature.
name: code_definition

include_body.description: Return the full definition body instead of the signature only (default false)

line.description: 1-based line number of the symbol use

path.description: File path containing the symbol use

project_id.description: Project id to search within (falls back to the configured default)
